resources.string: Point the top edge of your phone at a wall, then start a scan.
Stay in one place and turn slowly.
Top view of approximate echoes around your phone. Each grid square is one metre.
Start a scan to add points.

1. Disconnect headphones and Bluetooth audio. Set media volume to a moderate level.

2. Point the top edge of the screen toward a hard surface, about 0.55–5 m away. Leave the speaker and microphone uncovered.

3. Stay in one spot and rotate slowly. Stop and clear the map before moving to another spot.

The map shows approximate echo candidates from above. It does not identify walls or furniture. Height is included in CSV exports.

Save CSV writes to the app’s files folder; the saved path appears below the map.
